brief:
Only TikTok, Instagram Reels, Twitter(x) and YouTube Shorts are accepted.

Use footage from Dylan Page’s GTA 6 marathon starting November 19, 2026. Streams, VODs and clips from the marathon are all accepted.

Videos must be in 9:16 vertical format.

Dylan must be the main focus throughout the clip. Clips where he only appears in the intro will be rejected.

Include #DylanPage in the caption.

Post on an account that fits the content, such as gaming, streamer or entertainment pages.

No misleading edits, false claims or clips taken out of context to damage Dylan’s reputation.

No added watermarks or third-party branding. Logos already present in the original footage are allowed.

Thumbnails and captions must accurately reflect the clip. Do not reuse the same thumbnail across different clips. All captions and subtitles must be in English.

Submit only your own edits. Copying or reposting another creator’s edit is not allowed. You may publish your own edit on multiple accepted platforms.

Collab posts are not accepted.

Any artificial manipulation of views or engagement will result in rejection. Botting will result in a permanent ban from the campaign.

AI-generated footage, voices or fabricated reactions will result in a permanent ban from the campaign. Automatic subtitles are allowed.

sources.title: $5,000 Dylan Page GTA VI Marathon Campaign

brief:
The main goal of this campaign is to generate views, build awareness around finddmo, and drive traffic to finddmo’s Twitch channel

Prioritize finddmo and moments that make him entertaining, recognizable, or make viewers want to see more of his content

You have full creative freedom with editing, hooks, captions, pacing, format, and clip style. Do whatever you believe gives the content the best chance of going viral

You are encouraged to manufacture, reframe, remix, or creatively edit moments to put more attention on finddmo and create interest in his Twitch content

Other creators can be featured and used if it makes the clip more entertaining or increases its viral potential

Funny, competitive, controversial, reaction-worthy, and highly shareable angles are encouraged

Respect all women featured in the footage. Do not create degrading, humiliating, overly sexual, or disrespectful content involving them

Do not manufacture fake sexual or romantic narratives involving finddmo and women featured in the footage

Outside of these restrictions, creators have creative freedom. The goal is views that ultimately create curiosity around finddmo and funnel new viewers to his Twitch
requirements: Looking for creative clippers who understand viral short-form content and can turn stream/VOD moments into high-performing clips. You have freedom to experiment with hooks, edits, captions, narratives, and formats. The goal is to generate views, build the finddmo brand, and ultimately drive new viewers to finddmo on Twitch. Creativity and performance matter more than any specific editing style.
